work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Core contributor across Steampipe, Powerpipe, Flowpipe, and Tailpipe with 120+ merged pull requests and 9,300+ combined GitHub stars, shipping production backend and data-platform capabilities in Go.

Designed and developed a secure internal REST API microservice in Go (Gin) for Turbot Guardrails, implemented OAuth 2.0 (Auth0), containerized with Docker, deployed on AWS EC2, and integrated as a gRPC client with internal services.

Built a Kafka-based event-driven pipeline for policy-enforcement workflows with asynchronous consumers and webhook notifications, and added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) path for recurring-failure investigation.
Engineered high-volume data-pipeline features in Tailpipe (Go + DuckDB + Parquet), increasing throughput by 30% to 1,000+ logs/second while reducing memory usage to prevent out-of-memory failures.
Built the Steampipe MCP server in Python to provide LLM agents standardized real-time access to cloud and security data for retrieval and analysis.

Developed AI-powered workflows including a multi-agent orchestration system using OpenAI Agents SDK and a RAG-based internal Pydantic AI agent on AWS Lambda with S3 vector storage and Slack integration.
